user.title: Set up AC PID Frequency
user.description: The controller feeds the air conditioner a simulated external room temperature sensor and thereby steers it to a target compressor frequency. Pick the master indoor unit (for multi-split: the unit switched on first) and the entity that reports the compressor frequency.

data_description.climate_entity: This entity is read (target temperature, mode) and operated in the card. Its integration must support an external room sensor; enter the generated sensor there afterwards.
data_description.frequency_entity: Entity that reports the current compressor frequency as a number.
data_description.indoor_units: Optional. Shown small and read-only in the card.

abort.already_configured: An AC PID Frequency controller already exists for this air conditioner.

data_description.climate_entity: Target temperature and mode are read from this entity.
data_description.frequency_entity: Entity that reports the current compressor frequency as a number.
data_description.indoor_units: Optional. Display only in the card.

tuning.title: Control parameters
tuning.description: Defaults match the proven YAML controller. Target frequency and emergency-brake frequency are set directly via their entities or the card.

data.hold_limit: Max. held offset inside dead band
data.step_raise: Max. change per minute (frequency too low)
data.factor_floor: Learning factor: recovery value outside dead band
data.factor_up: Learning factor: increase inside dead band

data_description.interval_s: Seconds between two control steps. 60 s equals the YAML original; the per-minute step sizes are scaled automatically.
data_description.fault_timeout_min: If target temperature or Hz value is missing, the last sensor value is held for this long. Afterwards the sensor becomes unavailable and the AC uses its own indoor sensor again.
data_description.deadband_hz: Deviation from the target within which the offset is held.
data_description.offset_raise: The sensor is set this much colder than the setpoint when the frequency is too low (AC heats harder).
data_description.offset_lower: The sensor is set this much warmer than the setpoint when the frequency is too high. Acts immediately.
data_description.offset_brake: The sensor is set this much warmer than the setpoint when the emergency-brake frequency is exceeded.
data_description.hold_limit: Inside the dead band the last offset is held, but at most up to this value.
data_description.step_raise: Largest change of the sensor value per minute when the frequency is too low.
data_description.step_normal: Largest change of the sensor value per minute in all other cases.
data_description.max_offset: The sensor value always stays within setpoint ± this value.
data_description.hunting_hz: Frequency jump per step above which a direction change counts as hunting.
data_description.factor_min: Lower limit of the self-learning factor that scales the offset.
data_description.factor_max: Upper limit of the learning factor.
data_description.factor_floor: Outside the dead band the factor returns to at least this value.
data_description.factor_down: The factor drops by this much when hunting is detected.
data_description.factor_up: The factor rises by this much per step inside the dead band.

error.invalid_factor_range: Must satisfy: minimum ≤ recovery value ≤ maximum.
